purpose: Offline parser and editorial regression fixtures; genuine upstream excerpts, not complete source editions.
transformations: OSHB XML reserialized with ElementTree; chapters 1–2 retained. Logical Unicode word text, attributes and annotations preserved.
TBESH entries referenced by Proverbs 1–2 retained, columns 1–7 preserved. Column 8 (Meaning) removed and left empty.
attributions: Original work of the Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible available at https://github.com/openscriptures/morphhb. WLC text: public domain; lemma and morphology annotations: CC BY 4.0.
STEP Bible https://www.STEPBible.org — short Gloss fields and lexical metadata, CC BY 4.0, based on work at Tyndale House Cambridge. Long Meaning definitions excluded.
